## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it addresses. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement or refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update

## Core Principles Checklist
- [ ] **Zero Dependencies:** No external third-party SPM or CocoaPods packages added.
- [ ] **Privacy First:** No telemetry, tracking, analytics, or background servers introduced.
- [ ] **Local Storage:** All persistent data remains local under `~/Library/Application Support/Versoline`.
- [ ] **Build Validation:** Project builds cleanly with Xcode 16 / Swift 6 (`xcodegen generate` and `xcodebuild`).
- [ ] **Unit Tests:** Existing and new unit tests pass cleanly.
